commentary: Despite index-level strength on Monday driven by heavyweight Reliance, underlying market breadth remains narrow at a score of 21, confirming an inherently weak general market environment under O'Neil and Weinstein timing rules. Stan Weinstein's discipline dictates extreme selectivity when breadth fails to confirm index advances, while Jesse Livermore and Mark Minervini advocate progressive exposure and strict capital defense. In this posture, breakouts face elevated failure rates. Swing exposure must be restricted to genuine Stage 2 leaders displaying verified top-tier earnings acceleration and pristine technical pivots. Setups lacking fundamental confirmation must be capped at Watch or Avoid, and protective stops should be executed without compromise.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

21STCENMGM.technical: Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and rising SMA200, clearing a 20-session high to touch fresh 52-week peaks with positive MACD. However, micro-cap liquidity, erratic price discovery, and absence of an orderly Volatility Contraction Pattern leave this breakout mechanically fragile.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Severe operational losses (-₹17.2 Cr TTM) and negative ROE breach O'Neil's CANSLIM criteria. Lacking institutional sponsorship and durable operating revenues, the company trades purely as a speculative non-banking asset play.
21STCENMGM.risk: Violated on a close below 49.05; cut losses immediately given acute downside risk in low-grade speculative setups.

63MOONS.technical: Price maintains an overall uptrend above EMA21, SMA50, and rising SMA200. However, popping above the 967.57 double-bottom pivot and closing back beneath it creates a classic Livermore danger signal and Darvas false-breakout trap, indicating heavy overhead supply.
63MOONS.fundamental: Negative core operating profit (-₹98.8 Cr) and a depressed 1.5% ROE fail fundamental scrutiny. Reliance on non-operating other income cannot replace organic sales and operational cash flow under CANSLIM standards.
63MOONS.risk: Stop breached below 852.07; exit promptly to prevent getting caught in a confirmed double-bottom rejection.

ACUTAAS.technical: Textbook Stage 2 continuation trading within 1.5% of the 4036.23 pivot above rising 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages. Tight price action on 1.4x volume with positive MACD highlights orderly institutional accumulation near record highs.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM credentials with revenue up 43% YoY to ₹437 Cr and net profit jumping 71%, driven by semiconductor chemical demand and pharmaceutical intermediate margin expansion. Manageable debt and expanding returns support institutional sponsorship.
ACUTAAS.risk: Thesis invalidated on a breakdown under 3663.39; exit swiftly to preserve capital if broad market weakness drags the pivot.

AEROFLEX.technical: Constructive Stage 2 double bottom completing above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages. A 2.9x volume surge toward 614.31 validates institutional buying pressure, while an RSI of 53 leaves substantial momentum room before overbought readings.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM acceleration driven by rapid liquid-cooling demand, producing 87% revenue growth and a 157% surge in net profit. Negligible debt, robust cash generation, and ROCE exceeding 20% demonstrate genuine fundamental leadership.
AEROFLEX.risk: Setup fails below 527.24 neckline support; enforce Minervini stop discipline immediately to cap downside.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Decisive Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-session high backed by an immense 7.13x volume expansion. Price holds comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, though an RSI of 69 warns of near-term extension.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Dominant market position in organized eyecare yields steady 26% top-line growth. However, modest net profit growth near 10-14%, sub-6% ROE, and steep valuation (P/E > 100) fall short of the CANSLIM 25% earnings hurdle.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Invalidated if price breaks beneath 535; cut exposure to eliminate risk of a failed volume breakout.

ANUHPHR.technical: Constructing a double-bottom base above rising moving averages, punctuated by an 8.67x volume spike off the right low. Momentum is steady at RSI 59, but overhead resistance near the 100 psychological level requires digestion.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Clean balance sheet and high promoter ownership (71.8%) offer downside stability, but single-digit revenue growth (+4%) and decelerating EPS violate O'Neil's C+A leadership standards.
ANUHPHR.risk: Pattern breaks down on an undercut of 90.29; exit immediately to honor strict asymmetric loss limits.
